comments.author: Wen zhi
comments.body: Check "ornaments" link on the upper-left of this site. Tells you where to find most (though not all) ornament making NPCs.

comments.author: Rufas
comments.body:
As I have explained, many, MANY times.

The December update in Japan (which we are now in) made it so **R5** quarters can have an extra room where ornaments can be displayed for special effects.

Whenever I have said this I have also mentioned that the avoidance of battle due to 'ornament effect' was a bug. Yesterday I found confirmation of this in some update notes.
